pages.setting: Clinic waiting room beside an open corridor
pages.mainAction: A tiny glowing musical note springs from the nurse's metal vial into the red toy cart as Bunny jumps aboard.
pages.lighting: Soft clinic light with a warm glint around the note
continuityAnchors: red toy cart beside the child
tiny glowing note inside the cart

pages.setting: Clinic corridor imagined as a long silver flute
pages.mainAction: The child guides the transformed red railcar into the corridor while Bunny conducts with a cotton swab and three cotton balls tumble onto him.
pages.lighting: Bright corridor light with silvery reflections
continuityAnchors: red toy cart transformed into a railcar
tiny glowing note riding inside

pages.setting: Entrance to the clinic examination room
pages.mainAction: The child pauses at the doorway while the nurse presents round stickers and thin wires; Bunny lowers his cotton-swab baton beside the stopped railcar.
continuityAnchors: red railcar stopped beside the child
tiny glowing note inside the railcar
cotton-swab baton in Bunny's paw

pages.setting: Examination room imagined as a blue-wave crossing with the bed as a raft
pages.mainAction: The child raises a hand after the third sticker tickles, and the nurse immediately freezes while the wave, raft, and glowing note become perfectly still.
pages.lighting: Gentle clinical light blended with cool blue wave-glow
continuityAnchors: red railcar beside the examination bed
tiny glowing note frozen inside the railcar
cotton-swab baton lowered

pages.setting: Examination room imagined as a raft above a river of light
pages.mainAction: Bunny halts mid-clang beside the railcar as colored wire-strings stretch over a churning light river and the raft turns beneath the green monitor line.
pages.lighting: Green monitor glow over rippling colored light
continuityAnchors: stickers attached to the child
red railcar on the imagined crossing
tiny glowing note inside the railcar

pages.setting: Examination room with a transparent bridge above the imagined light river

pages.lighting: Steady clinical light with a soft pulse from the bridge
continuityAnchors: stickers and colored wires attached
red railcar beside the bridge
tiny glowing note inside the railcar

pages.lighting: Calm rhythmic bands of light along the bridge
continuityAnchors: stickers and colored wires attached

transparent bridge controlled by the child's breathing

pages.lighting: Clinical light with a sharp flash of motion around the note

pages.mainAction: The nurse watches the monitor, the child sets the breathing pace, and Bunny grips the railcar while guarding the note, leaving his fallen cotton-swab baton behind.

continuityAnchors: stickers and colored wires attached
